fields.description: Create a ToDo assignment for the recipient on each referral.
fields.label: Create ToDo Assignment

fields.description: Also send an email to the recipient (requires an outgoing email account).
fields.label: Send Email Notification

fields.description: Push live updates to the Cartable (Inbox) SPA.
fields.label: Realtime Inbox Update

fields.description: An open referral older than this many days is flagged as overdue.
fields.label: Overdue After (Days)

fields.description: Send a reminder notification when a referral becomes overdue.
fields.label: Notify On Overdue

fields.description: Pre-selected as the type for new letters. Leave blank for none.
fields.label: Default Letter Type

fields.description: Assign the secretariat number (شماره نامه) automatically when a letter is registered (submitted) without one, e.g. 1405/00012. The counter restarts every Jalali year.
fields.label: Auto Letter Number (شماره‌گذاری خودکار)

fields.description: Optional text placed before the number, e.g. «م-» gives م-1405/00012.
fields.label: Letter Number Prefix

fields.description: When enabled, registered letters that are NOT marked Private and whose confidentiality is Normal can be read by every Office Automation user (the «عمومی» folder). Private, Confidential and Secret letters always stay limited to their parties.
fields.label: Public Letters Visible To All Users
